title: COPD exacerbation, home with home health, summary + nursing + case management all complete

rationale.pac_list: Case management note documents that a list of Medicare-certified providers of the referred level of care was given to the patient and family.
rationale.pac_choice: Case management note documents freedom of choice and that the patient's selected provider was used.
rationale.pac_quality_data: Case management note documents that Care Compare quality ratings were reviewed with the patient and family.
rationale.meds_consistent: Both documents list the same seven items (prednisone, doxycycline, tiotropium-olodaterol, albuterol, apixaban, diltiazem, oxygen); the nursing note's mention of the old Spiriva is a stop instruction consistent with the summary's medication changes.
rationale.goals_of_care: DNR with POLST and stated goal of staying home are documented.
